title: Tunisian-Style Indian Omelette
description: A twist on the classic Indian omelette, infused with the flavors of Tunisia. Perfect for a quick brunch.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork.
Add the nutty and tunisian spices, if using, and mix well.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add a small amount of oil.
Pour in the egg mixture and cook until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
Continue cooking until the eggs are almost set and the omelette is cooked through.
Slide the omelette out of the pan onto a plate and serve hot.
